以上为锁定的计划条件；实际训练配置文件、SHA 和完整数据锁见 实验条件 JSON。各组均从 J256 开始，创建新优化器并额外训练 1024 步。Body 参数组学习率：2.5e-5 / 1.25e-5 / 2.5e-6；Face：5e-5 / 2.5e-5 / 5e-6；warmup 20 步。FP32 Adapter 与优化器状态，BF16 主干计算，batch=1。

Body 接收 normal、Body25、part、26 维 SMPL-X global 与 mask；Face 独立接收目标面部几何和 A 身份。Depth、DWPose 本轮用于 PE 和核对图，不表示已启用相应 Adapter 分支。服装设计、颜色和纹理由 A 保持，褶皱与姿态阴影允许适应新动作。

推理 30 步、CFG=1，Body=1、Face=1、Hand=0；每 128 步保留检查点与监测推理。完整验证每 256 步使用 seed 42/43。独立测试在全部八组训练完成后仅推理，不进行反向传播。

  • RGB 唯一输入: 源图 A RGB 为 Qwen 生成模型的唯一 RGB 输入；目标 B 可用于 PB/PBG 的 PE 重写、数值几何、尺寸与离线评分。验证/测试 B 不进入 Qwen 参考条件或目标 latent 缓存。
  • PB / PBG 边界: B RGB 只给 PE 观察并转写可见姿态；训练 B latent 是监督目标，不能与图像参考混淆。测试 B 可用于几何和离线评分，不进入 Qwen 参考条件。
  • 原生分辨率评测: 保持 TikTok 原图高宽比，在原尺寸画布上进行反补边 (unpad) 后计算指标 (per_sample_native)。

预定种子的尝试齐全后，在每个样本内求有效指标均值，再按原始视频组宏平均。缺少预定任务的样本保持缺失，曲线留空档；无脸或无效检测保留 None 并单列计数。推理种子与同视频样本不视作独立训练重复。

尚无满足完整种子与评分证据的有效曲线点。

Instruction:
Write one standalone English image-edit instruction for changing the pose of the person in the source photograph. The source photograph supplies the person's facial identity, hair, clothing design, garment colors and material texture, accessories, and background. Describe the desired body pose, head direction, facial expression, and hand configuration only to the extent they are observable in the permitted target references. Preserve the source identity and outfit while allowing head orientation, expression, limb position, cloth folds and pose-dependent shadows to adapt. Keep the source scene, camera framing and overall illumination. Preserve source props, held objects, logos and accessories; pose-only guides cannot justify removing them. Use only viewer image-left and image-right for spatial directions, never mix them with anatomical left/right. Omit uncertain or invisible joint and finger details. Never transfer another person's identity, clothes or scene, and never render skeleton lines or normal/depth visualization colors. The editor keeps the source canvas: do not invent below-frame legs, hands, feet or new framing. The final prompt must state the visible pose changes explicitly and be understandable when the editor receives only the source RGB and numerical geometry controls. Write a single detailed paragraph of approximately 200 to 320 English words. State the edit directly, then source preservation and natural pose-dependent cloth/light changes. The final prompt must not mention Image numbers, reference images, depth/normal/skeleton maps, adapters, target guides, or unseen controls; express the reliable target pose in words.
Image 1: This source photograph supplies the person's identity, hair, outfit, accessories and scene.
Image 2: This grayscale visualization encodes target depth and occlusion; it supplies no clothing or identity appearance.
Image 3: These RGB colors encode target surface orientation; they are not skin, fabric or lighting colors.
Image 4: This confidence-filtered skeleton encodes visible target joints; black regions and omitted joints supply no hidden anatomy.
Geometry-only mode: a fitted bare SMPL-X face is not evidence of a real smile, speaking mouth, gaze or emotion. Describe only reliable target head orientation. Do not freeze the source head tilt, gaze or expression. When a target expression cannot be established from geometry, omit expression and gaze instructions entirely; do not request that the source expression be preserved. Missing or disagreeing hand/finger/leg estimates must be omitted rather than guessed. The absence of a source prop in a bare-body geometry render is not evidence that the prop should be deleted.
